note: USACE campground on the south (Nebraska) bank of the Missouri just below Gavins Point Dam, between Hwy 121 and the river: one long row of back-in sites under trees, facing the river across the campground road and the riprap bank. Boat ramp, accessible fishing pier and bank fishing at the west end; fish-cleaning station. Bald eagles year-round. Lewis and Clark Visitor Center up the hill. --Claude
summary: Recreation.gov confirms 34 electric (50 A) sites plus 2 tent-only, showers, flush toilets and a dump, a 14-night limit, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums and a May 13 - October 11 reservable peak season; written. The base rate is $24 (electric); the stored $20 is the tent-only price and is replaced. On the per-site plot every RV pad backs onto the campground's own gravel road, which runs along the riprap bank between the sites and the Missouri: riverfront should come down to riverview. Pin is at the boat ramp, ~330 m west of the site row.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> riverview (lead): rec.gov per-site points for sites 04-34 plotted on Esri and NAIP sit in one row of back-in pads whose open ends face the river, but the campground's own gravel road runs the whole length between the pads and the riprap bank; pads end ~35-50 m from the water across that road and the bank. Under AWH 2026-11-01 a campground's own road blocks on-water. The view across the road is open (no trees on the river side), so riverview. Sites 01-03 (west end) sit by the boat-ramp parking lot; 35-36 are tent sites at the east end.
FEES: stored nightly_low/high 20 (provenance 2026-10-09, rec.gov rates) is the TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC price; every RV site is STANDARD ELECTRIC at $24. Replaced with 24/24.

PIN (~330 m): stored 42.8490,-97.4680 is on the boat ramp at the river's edge (rec.gov's facility point 42.8489,-97.4703 is also at the ramp area). The centre of the RV row (sites 04-34) is 42.8476,-97.4644. Suggest moving.
SEASON: no availability rows outside the peak season (November-April); nothing states whether the campground stays open off-season, so season left unknown and only booking.season written.
